name: io.github.iowarp/geoservices-mcp
title: CLIO Geoservices
description: Fetch geospatial data where it is served: ArcGIS REST, OGC WFS and WCS, STAC, remote rasters and...

tools.name: describe_geo_service
tools.description: Identify a geospatial URL and describe it: ArcGIS FeatureServer/MapServer/ImageServer layers, fields, record count and real data extent; OGC WFS feature types; WCS coverages (filter by words) or one coverage's grid; a remote raster's CRS, size, resolution and units; an Entwine/EPT or COPC point cloud's extent and point count; a STAC catalog. With bbox, reports whether the declared or measured extent overlaps it. Entwine viewer links are followed to their point cloud.

tools.name: fetch_features
tools.description: Fetch vector features from an ArcGIS FeatureServer/MapServer layer (bbox and SQL where clause) or an OGC WFS feature type (bbox), paging through the service's record limit, and save them as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection in EPSG:4326. count_only returns just the number of matching features, which is the reliable way to test coverage when a layer's declared extent is wrong.

tools.name: read_raster_window
tools.description: Read only the part of one or more rasters inside a region and save it as one GeoTIFF: remote or local GeoTIFF/COG, VRT mosaics, ArcGrid (.adf) and IMG tiles through ranged HTTP reads, or an OGC WCS coverage subset (give coverage_id). Tiles in different CRSs are warped to one. The output is decimated to max_cells and the decimation is reported. Returns CRS, shape, resolution, units, valid fraction, region_not_covered (the part of the region no source reaches, with its box) and statistics.

tools.name: read_point_cloud
tools.description: Read the lidar points inside a region from an Entwine Point Tiles (ept.json) dataset, such as USGS 3DEP's public bucket (Entwine viewer links are accepted), or a COPC .copc.laz file, and save them as LAZ. Reads the finest octree level that fits max_points and reports the level, point spacing and whether the result is full density. Optional classification filter (2 = ground).

tools.name: search_stac
tools.description: Find STAC items by region, time interval (e.g. 2020-01-01/2021-12-31) and collection, through a STAC API search or a bounded walk of a static catalog. Saves the items as GeoJSON and returns each item's id, time, bbox and asset links.

prompts.name: fetch_region
prompts.description: Guided workflow: describe a service, check coverage, fetch the region.
